note: Majority: null. The Code des personnes et de la famille was not read; the Secretariat-General of the Government (sgg.gouv.ml) did not answer. Work: Loi n° 92-020 du 23 septembre 1992 portant Code du travail, art. L.187 (FAOLEX's copy of the ILO NATLEX web text): children may not be employed in any undertaking, even as apprentices, before fourteen, save a written derogation by order of the Minister of Labour, given local circumstances and the tasks asked of them. This is the 1992 text; whether later amendments raised the age was not checked (the labour ministry's travail.gouv.ml did not answer). Performers: no exception for performing in the text read; the derogation is a general ministerial order, so the form holds barred (my reading). Service: null. No defence or national-service law was read.

sources.title: Mali, Loi n° 92-020 du 23 septembre 1992 portant Code du travail (FAOLEX, from ILO NATLEX web text)
sources.said: Les enfants ne peuvent être employés dans aucune entreprise, même comme apprentis, avant l’âge de quatorze ans, sauf dérogation écrite édictée par arrêté du Ministre chargé du travail
